mentions.name: Meltdown
mentions.description: Meltdown is an AI harness and platform built in Python and Tkinter, featuring many advanced features, arguments (452), commands and shortcuts. Its widgets and markdown parser were written from scratch, and it provides a powerful API for creating interactive conversational sessions with extensive configurability.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For the last couple of months I was working daily, and intensely, on Meltdown. The project started in 2024, but I retook it recently and improved/extended it a lot.

https://meltdown.merkoba.com

This is an AI Harness + Platform, made in Python and Tkinter.
